facts.fact: Paradigm Initiative says Zambia's Cybersecurity and Cybercrime Act of 2025 was used around the August 2026 elections, which shows the Act is in force.

Paradigm Initiative, citing the African Union's preliminary report, says ZNBC journalist MacPherson Mukuka was arrested under section 10 of the cybercrime law, on recording a private conversation, during the August 2026 elections.
